# Xiaomi Global
> Official global website for Xiaomi products, support resources, company information, and regional consumer services.

Xiaomi Global showcases Xiaomi and Redmi devices, wearables, smart home products, lifestyle products, support documentation, warranty information, and corporate policies for international users.

## Product Categories
- [Mobile](https://www.mi.com/global/mobile/): Browse Xiaomi and Redmi smartphones available on the global site.
- [Wearables](https://www.mi.com/global/wearables/): Explore smart bands, smartwatches, and other wearable devices.
- [Smart Home](https://www.mi.com/global/smart-home/): Discover connected home devices, appliances, and smart living products.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.mi.com/global/life-style/): View personal electronics and lifestyle-oriented Xiaomi products.

## Discover
- [Discover](https://www.mi.com/global/discover/): Read featured stories, launches, campaigns, and product highlights from Xiaomi Global.

## Support
- [Support Home](https://www.mi.com/global/support/): Access Xiaomi customer support, service information, and help resources.
- [Contact Us](https://www.mi.com/global/support/contact/): Find official Xiaomi contact channels for customer assistance.
- [User Guide](https://www.mi.com/global/support/user-guide/): Browse product manuals and user guide documentation.
- [Warranty](https://www.mi.com/global/support/warranty/): Review warranty terms and after-sales support information.
- [International Warranty Service](https://www.mi.com/global/support/xiaomi-iws/): Learn about Xiaomi international warranty service coverage and conditions.
- [Scooter Safety Notice](https://www.mi.com/global/support/scooter-safety-notice/): Read official safety notices related to Xiaomi scooters.
- [Android Enterprise Recommended](https://www.mi.com/global/support/android-enterprise-recommended/): View Xiaomi devices and information for Android Enterprise Recommended programs.

## Compliance and Policy Documents
- [EU Declaration of Conformity](https://www.mi.com/global/service/support/declaration.html): Access regulatory conformity declarations for Xiaomi products in the EU.
- [Digital Services Act](https://www.mi.com/global/support/policy/digital-service-act/): Review Xiaomi information and disclosures related to the Digital Services Act.
- [Data Act](https://www.mi.com/global/support/documents/data-act/): Read Xiaomi documentation and notices related to the Data Act.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.mi.com/global/about/privacy/): Review Xiaomi Global privacy practices and personal data handling terms.

## Company
- [About Xiaomi](https://www.mi.com/global/about/): Learn about Xiaomi’s mission, business, and global brand presence.
- [Leadership Team](https://www.mi.com/global/about/founder/): Meet Xiaomi leadership and founder-related company information.

## Community
- [Xiaomi Community Global](https://new.c.mi.com/global?utm_source=mistore&utm_medium=official_web_tabcommunity&utm_campaign=official_web_mistore_global/?t=1): Join the global Xiaomi community for discussions, news, and user engagement.

## Brand and Ecosystem
- [POCO](https://www.mi.com/global/): Access Xiaomi Global entry point for the broader device ecosystem.
- [Xiaomi Global Home](https://www.mi.com/global/): Start from the global homepage to navigate products and services.
